title: Recovery and updates
summary: Daily verified automatic updates, clearer layout recovery, durable Space-image replacement, and safer persistence make Arras easier to trust.
details: Recent Layout History is now clearly separated from portable .arras backups and explains exactly what restoring will replace.
Per-photo schedules support weekday, daytime, and overnight windows with a useful summary in each photo row.
Space-image replacement, archive import, revision retention, and persistence failures now follow one durable model path.
Every release must provide deliberate human-authored notes that CI uses for both the GitHub release and updater message.
